headerDisplay: Shelly devices over the local network. Energy meters report per-phase power, voltage, current and energy to OpenBridge, with history charting. Gen2+ relays are exposed as switches you can control from OpenBridge and HomeKit. A relay wired to a step-by-step gate operator, with its limit switches on two inputs, can be exposed as a gate in HomeKit instead.
footerDisplay: Supported: Shelly 3EM and EM (Gen1), and Gen2+ devices with relay or energy-meter components (Plus/Pro 1/2/4PM, Pro 3EM, Plus Uni). A Gen2+ device with a relay and two limit inputs can be presented as a gate. Roller-cover mode is not supported yet.

ip.title: IP address
ip.description: IP address or hostname of the Shelly device on your local network.

name.title: Name
name.description: Prefix for the devices this meter creates, e.g. "Home" produces "Home - Total" and "Home - Phase A".

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read the device. Lower values give finer power resolution at the cost of more network traffic.

showTotal.title: Show combined total
showTotal.description: Register one device summing every phase.

phaseNames.title: Phase names
phaseNames.description: Labels for each phase. Defaults to Phase A, Phase B, Phase C.

exposeToHomeKit.title: Expose to HomeKit
exposeToHomeKit.description: Publish this device to HomeKit. Meter channels appear as a light sensor whose lux value carries watts (HomeKit has no power characteristic); relay channels appear as switches. To show a relay as a light or outlet instead, use the device inspector in OpenBridge — it re-applies the choice on every restart.

alertThreshold.title: Alert threshold (watts)
alertThreshold.description: Adds a HomeKit contact sensor that opens above this power level. 0 disables it.

username.title: Username (optional)
username.description: Only needed if the device has HTTP authentication enabled.

password.title: Password (optional)
password.description: Only needed if the device has HTTP authentication enabled.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: Present this device as a gate instead of bare relays. For a step-by-step gate operator: one relay wired to the control board's step input, and two inputs tapped off its limit switches. Leave empty for a normal relay device.

switch.title: Step relay
switch.description: Relay index wired to the control board's step input. Give it an auto-off timer of about 500 ms in the Shelly app so each command is a clean pulse.

openInput.title: Open limit input
openInput.description: Input index that reads high when the gate is fully open.

closedInput.title: Closed limit input
closedInput.description: Input index that reads high when the gate is fully closed. Must differ from the open limit input.

travelTime.title: Travel time (seconds)
travelTime.description: How long a full open or close may take before the gate is assumed to have stopped. The limit switches cannot tell a stopped gate from a moving one, so this is the only way to notice.

pulseGap.title: Pulse gap (ms)
pulseGap.description: Pause between pulses when reaching a target needs more than one step. Reversing a moving gate takes two: one to stop it, one to send it back.

invertInputs.title: Inverted limit sensing
invertInputs.description: Treat a low input as "at the limit". Needed when the limit switches are wired so the input drops rather than rises at the end of travel.

departureSettle.title: Departure settle (ms)
departureSettle.description: How long the gate may still be pressing the limit switch it was told to leave before that reading is believed again. A gate sits on its limit for a second or two after the motor starts; reading that as "still parked" makes the plugin think it never set off. Raise it for a slow or heavy gate.

switch:0.title: Relay channel 0
switch:0.description: Overrides for the switch:0 channel on a Gen2+ relay. Ignored on Gen1 meters.

exclude.title: Ignore this channel
exclude.description: Do not register this channel as a device at all.

switch:1.description: Overrides for the switch:1 channel on a Gen2+ relay. Ignored on Gen1 meters.
